construction: Re-sample the same continuous roof, shoulder, wrapped native stone field and shallow cavities with adaptive object-space edge subdivision. Freeze canonical endpoint collars and copied native terminal caps. Conforming edge vertices use actual evaluated centers for cell fans; no collinear hanging-edge fans. Continuous surface derivatives provide native smooth normals, with actual canonical normals at W/N boundaries.

nativeTessellation.method: Adaptive native 3D edge-length subdivision of the same continuous geometric field; shared edge stitching, no render or pixel fit. Exact .025 endpoint collars retain their original sampling.

normalReconstruction.method: Continuous object-space native surface derivatives in float64; no raster or view-dependent operation. Same geometry field/material/capture as round04. Actual canonical endpoint normals override reconstructed interior shading.

comparison: candidates/round-05/native-round04-round05-comparison.json records actual changed body coordinates/topology/albedo/normals and identical canonical cap data. Resampling changes per-vertex values; it is not claimed byte-identical to round04.
capture: Frozen canonical camera, material, lights, Cycles48 seed0 BOX1.5 no denoise; whole native4x BOX to published2x. No post-raster repair.
